symptoms_en: Brown spots with rings like a bull's eye and a yellow edge on leaves; fruit is infected at the stalk end and shows brown rings.
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों पर पीले किनारे वाले, छल्लेदार भूरे धब्बे; फल डंठल की ओर से संक्रमित होता है और उस पर भूरे छल्ले दिखते हैं।

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: diseases of tomato
symptoms_en.quote: Brown spots with concentric rings in a bull's eye pattern with yellow margin. Fruit gets infected through calyx or stem attachment.

management_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: diseases of tomato
management_en.quote: Removal and destruction of crop debris. Crop rotation. Seed treatment: Trichoderma asperellum @ 4g/kg seeds

recipe_slugs.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
recipe_slugs.quote: Alternaria blight management: On appearance of symptoms, spray 7–10 days old buttermilk
recipe_slugs.note: Natural-farming guide (NITI); the recipe is matched to the pest class, not tested on this crop in Malwa.

management_en: Remove and destroy crop debris, rotate crops, and treat seed with Trichoderma (4 g per kg).
management_hi: फसल के अवशेष हटाकर नष्ट करें, फसल चक्र अपनाएँ और बीज को ट्राइकोडर्मा (4 ग्राम प्रति किलो) से उपचारित करें।
source_notes: AI research (2026-10-07). Organic and cultural steps only are listed under management; chemical sprays in the sources are left out. Escalation advice is not sourced yet (TODO(agronomist)). Favoured by warm, humid, wet weather (24-29 °C); the source gives no months.
